name: Diagnostics
description: We test the machine and tell you exactly what has failed and what it costs to fix, for $24.99, before you commit to any repair.
includes: Full hardware test covering drive, memory and power
A written list of what has failed
A firm price for the repair before any work starts

name: Windows installation
description: A clean Windows installation for $44.99, including Microsoft Office and security software, with all drivers set up so the machine works out of the box.
includes: All hardware drivers installed and tested

name: Virus removal
description: Malware, adware and browser hijackers removed for $34.99, with security software left in place so the machine does not pick the same thing up again.
includes: Full scan and removal of malware and adware
Browser hijackers and unwanted toolbars removed
Security software installed and set to update itself

name: Desktop clean-up and tune-up
description: A full clean-up and tune-up for $79.99, covering both the software slowing the machine down and the dust cooking it from the inside.
includes: Startup programs and background tasks cleared out
Dust removed from fans and heatsinks

name: Program installation, each
description: Any single program installed and set up for $24.99, including licensing and first-run configuration.

name: Hardware installation, each
description: Any single component fitted for $24.99, covering the labour to install memory, a drive or a card. The part itself is extra.

name: Password reset
description: A locked Windows account reset for $49.99, so you get back into the machine without losing the files on it.
includes: Windows local or Microsoft account access restored
Files on the machine left in place

name: Laptop screen replacement
description: A cracked or failed laptop screen replaced from $120, including the panel and the labour. The final price depends on the size and resolution of the panel your model takes.
includes: Hinges and cables checked while the machine is open
60-day warranty on the panel and the work

name: DC / charging port replacement
description: A worn or broken laptop charging socket replaced for $109.99, including stripping the machine down and testing charging under load before reassembly.

name: Laptop keyboard replacement
description: A laptop keyboard replaced for between $69.99 and $149.99. The range is real: on some laptops the keyboard is a separate part, and on others it is riveted into the whole top case, which costs more.
